accepted_statement: For every finite fair-bit restriction tree with node-unique fresh selectors and arbitrary fully shared Boolean terminal cores, the weighted upper-set charge is at most terminal weighted H-U minus root H-U, plus one weighted raw child-difference entropy term per node, plus (3/ln2) times actual selector influence.
scope_corrections: Single-use means one ledger appearance per node, not disjoint ownership of underlying physical data coordinates.
Selectors must be node-unique, fresh, and absent from terminal cores for sum_v w_v q_v to equal physical selector influence.
The retained raw difference-spectrum entropy is unpaid; no U<=K I or FEI class theorem follows.
